messages:
sam: Heads up — saw a bunch of downstream apps hit ~600KB extra in their edge bundles after upgrading to @redwood-inference/js-sdk v2.1.0. bundle analyzer shows tons of internal helpers pulled in.
jen: ugh. is this the ESM/CJS dual entry thing?
sam: looks like it. webpack/next is resolving the CJS entry for some builds which brings in commonjs wrapper and prevents tree-shaking. Edge runtime (Vercel Edge) runs ESM only, but the bundler still included the cjs shim.
matt: can you paste your package.json exports? we added a new export map in v2 but maybe it's not exhaustive.
sam: sure — minimal repro package.json from a downstream app:
```json
{
  "name": "example-app",
  "type": "module",
  "dependencies": {
    "@redwood-inference/js-sdk": "^2.1.0"
  }
}
```
sam: bundler trace points to resolving `require('@redwood-inference/js-sdk')` to `dist/index.cjs.js` because of fallback in our published package.
jen: do we publish both dist/index.mjs and dist/index.cjs? and do we set "exports" properly?
sam: npm package has:
```json
"main": "dist/index.cjs.js",
"module": "dist/index.mjs",
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js"
  }
}
```
sam: also we ship some files under `lib/` that have top-level side effects (register global polyfills for edge-side logging). that prevents aggressive tree-shaking unless "sideEffects" is set correctly.
alisa: do we have "sideEffects": false in package.json? if we set false while shipping files with side effects we break users.
matt: right — current published package doesn't include a sideEffects field so webpack defaults to conservative behavior and may include files. The bigger problem is some bundlers prefer the CJS resolution path for compatibility, so they pull the CJS bundle which includes the whole runtime.
jen: short-term fix: publish a patch where exports only expose the ESM entry for environment="browser"/edge while keeping CJS behind a separate import path. Also add a proper "types"/"exports" with conditional exports for types.
sam: repro steps I used: Next.js app (next 13), add sdk, build with production mode, run `npx webpack-bundle-analyzer .next/static/chunks/pages/index.html` and look for `@redwood-inference/js-sdk/dist/index.cjs.js`.
matt: can we change packaging to avoid bundling helpers into cjs? e.g., use rollup instead of tsc-only for cjs build and mark helpers as external helpers, or use `tslib` for helpers.
alisa: we also need to audit for top-level side effects — the logging polyfill should be lazy-init behind a function call and not executed on import.
jen: proposed release: v2.1.1 — changes: add "sideEffects" array listing exception files (or set false if none), export map conditional on "import"/"require" and "node"/"browser" fields, add `exports."./dist/edge"` to point to an ESM-only edge-friendly entry, and switch cjs build to use tslib. Also update README with migration notes for bundlers.
sam: can someone pair on a minimal repro repo? I can push what I have.
matt: I'll look at the build pipeline. if we expose a dedicated edge entry, Next.js edge bundler should pick it up when used in edge runtime.
jen: also heads-up about types: some users reported their TS server still auto-imports deep paths e.g., `@redwood-inference/js-sdk/lib/logging` which pulls side-effects. Adding exported subpath stubs in "exports" with a runtime-only marker would stop accidental deep imports.
alisa: good call. add `"exports": { "./logging": "./dist/logging.mjs" }` etc. and ship typed d.ts for each export to keep editor DX.
sam: thanks everyone. I'll open a patch PR with repro and the package.json changes. will tag people. :sparkles:
build-bot: CI triggered for sam/edge-sdk-fix #342 — build queued :construction:
jen: awesome — once PR is up, can we run a canary across a couple of sample apps (next-edge, cloudflare-pages) to validate edge bundle size ?
matt: yes, add a small e2e script: build + analyze. I can add it to the release checklist.
sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/342 — includes changelog and bundle analyzer snapshot.
jen: thanks — big DX win if this reduces P95 edge bundle size. :thumbsup:
